steps.title: Introduction
steps.description: A member of Congress introduces the bill in the House or Senate.

steps.title: Committee
steps.description: A committee studies, amends and votes on the bill.

steps.title: Floor vote
steps.description: The full chamber debates and votes on the bill.

steps.title: Other chamber
steps.description: The other chamber repeats the process and must pass the same text.

steps.title: President
steps.description: The President signs the bill into law or vetoes it.
